title: A strong back with no dumbbells: 4 floor raises, easiest to hardest
caption: Back exercises at home with no dumbbells: four floor raises from easiest to hardest, each with its reps and the test that says you are ready for the next. Shoulder Blade Squeeze, Prone W Raise, Prone Y Raise, then Prone Y-T-W Raise at the top. Save the ladder.

overlays.text: A strong back with no dumbbells: four floor raises, easiest to hardest.

scenes.footer: Ready when all 12 feel smooth and slow.

overlays.text: Shoulder Blade Squeeze. 12 reps. Lie face down, pull your shoulder blades together.

scenes.footer: Ready when you can pause at the top of every rep.

overlays.text: Prone W Raise. 10 reps. Face down, elbows bent in a W, lift your arms off the floor.

scenes.footer: Ready when your arms stay up for a slow count of two.

overlays.text: Prone Y Raise. 10 reps. Face down, arms long in a Y, lift them off the floor.

scenes.footer: This is lifting the box onto the top shelf and holding it there.

overlays.text: Prone Y-T-W Raise. 5 reps. Face down, lift your arms in a Y, then a T, then a W.

scenes.footer: Every rung you hold is strength you own.

overlays.text: The top rung takes weeks, not days.
